scalars.scalar_value: 4 – 9 hour shifts and 1 – 4 hour shift per week. The scheduled days will be Tuesday – Saturday, half day on Saturday.

items.item_text: Primary job duty will be to provide direct patient care at Sacramento, Folsom or Roseville Express Care outpatient clinic location providing same day access for patients. Express Care physicians do not manage a patient panel and have minimal inbox responsibilities. As a physician with UC Davis Health you will have access to Epic as the EMR and AI scribe, Abridge.
Active and unrestricted CA Medical License
Active and unrestricted DEA license or license eligible
Successful completion of US Family Medicine Residency Program

Ability to access, understand, and use health information and services to make appropriate health decisions, this includes understanding medical terminology and instructions for medications and treatments
Ability to communicate health concerns, ask questions, and clearly communicate needs and preferences to healthcare providers
Skills and knowledge to manage chronic conditions and implement healthy lifestyle practices
Understand how to use the healthcare system, schedule appointments, and access resources effectively
Capacity to participate in decisions about patients' healthcare by collaborating with providers and understanding treatment options and their implications
